text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, happy birthday! Diamond and I
have an
original song to present to
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Your sisters entrusted us with the
important task
of throwing a big
celebration for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, I hope you enjoy.
Cheval is always
super serious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Every day in class, her posture's
fabulous. ♪
Her notes are so neat, the
teacher praises her on
repeat! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
At cleaning time, she's super serious
too. ♪
She cleans every corner, every
spot and every
speck on the floor, so it
looks brand-new! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And when we move classrooms, she's the
last one
there. ♪
Making sure nobody's
left anything behind!
She's delightful,
and so very smart, and kind! ♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
E-enough! I can't take any more of this!
I-I'm
going to explode!
